The '''Sinkars''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Helium/Legends|helium]]-based [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slugs]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sinkar]]. They survived on [[Star/Legends|solar energy]] and impurities extracted from the planet's surface. [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] rumors conflicted as to the exact nature of the Sinkars&mdash;some claimed that the slugs were [[Telepathy/Legends|telepaths]] of great strength who communicated wisdom accumulated over a long lifetime. Others claimed they were mindless creatures, capable of sucking energy from other beings or [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engine/Legends|drives]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Sinkars were a [[Helium/Legends|helium]]-based [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slugs]]. They resembled huge [[Color/Legends|black]] amoebas slowly oozing across the surface of their [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Sinkar]]. They extracted impurities in the [[Water/Legends|snowy]] [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] layer that covered the planet, and they utilized [[Star/Legends|solar energy]].<ref name="SWCP" />

==History==
The Sinkars evolved on the planet Sinkar, located in the [[Lawreys system]] of the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. The planet was at the outer extreme of its [[Star system/Legends|star system]], and, as a consequence, it was frigid, with its oxygen frozen on the surface. Although that rendered the high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] world inhospitable for conventional life, it did give rise to the helium-based Sinkars.<ref name="SWCP" />

Conflicting rumors abounded in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as to the exact nature of the Sinkars. According to some opinions, the beings were long-lived, amassing great wisdom over the course of their lifetimes. Slow and ponderous thinkers, the Sinkars were rumored to communicate their thoughts [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathically]] to those who were patient enough. Other theories claimed the Sinkars were mindless creatures, capable of sucking energy directly from a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Engine/Legends|drives]]&mdash;or even from another [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]].<ref name="SWCP" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] outpost on the Sinkar homeworld, although they did not disclose the purpose of this installation.<ref name="SWCP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sinkars were created by [[Paul Murphy]] for the [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1988]]. The information on the Sinkars was presented as competing rumors with none definitively confirmed. The section featuring the Sinkars was later republished in ''[[Classic Campaigns]]'' in [[1994]], albeit in an abridged form.
